# Alexandr Chumak

> EU citizen, no sponsorship required for EU roles. Senior Frontend / Product Engineer with 6+ years building production web and mobile software in React, TypeScript and Next.js. Frontend Developer at TeamArt Outsourcing from Feb 2021 to Aug 2026. Open to senior frontend and product-engineering roles across the EU, available immediately.

At TeamArt, from Feb 2021 to Dec 2025 on EVCARGO, a logistics and transport CRM for a UK logistics operator, web and mobile: built and maintained the shared design system and component library, built the React Query and Axios data layer covering auth refresh, caching, pagination, filtering, invalidation and error handling, contributed to the React Native app and cross-platform releases including Android SDK upgrades and iOS release validation, introduced Playwright coverage for critical flows, and ran frontend code review. Then from Jan 2026 to Aug 2026 on Multisoft, a restaurant CRM for a Romanian HoReCa software vendor with three separate apps for administrators, kitchen staff and waiters: the only frontend engineer on the project, built all three in Next.js and TypeScript from scratch, designed and documented the component system, routing structure and frontend conventions, and implemented dense tables, filtering, validation and long forms over REST APIs. Built and deployed Rivella solo, a multi-tenant AI booking assistant running in production: a Next.js and TypeScript admin panel over a NestJS and Prisma API on PostgreSQL 16, a tenant-scoped data model with non-null tenant keys across all 12 tenant-scoped tables, one bot process per tenant behind per-slug webhook routing, an assistant that answers through a bounded tool-calling loop over 15 tools with PostgreSQL full-text search over each tenant's knowledge base, Telegram and YClients integrations for availability and bookings, five scheduled jobs, 138 API tests passing across 12 suites behind a 46-path OpenAPI spec, shipped as Docker images built in GitHub Actions and deployed to a VPS. Built Prosvetum solo, an iOS book-summary app published on the App Store in September 2026: React Native (Expo), TypeScript and NativeWind, with audio, quizzes, spaced-repetition flashcards and an AI mentor; a Supabase backend on PostgreSQL with row-level security and Edge Functions for chat, recommendations and audio delivery; mentor answers grounded in vector search over Voyage embeddings in pgvector; the TanStack Query cache persisted to AsyncStorage; Sentry error monitoring and EAS builds. Built Profit Controller solo, restaurant analytics that turns iiko POS data into ranked findings quantified in money and backed by evidence: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL and better-auth, an assistant on the Claude API that explains the computed metrics, 600+ Vitest tests plus integration and Playwright end-to-end tests in GitHub Actions, deployed with Docker and Caddy. Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, React Native, Expo, NativeWind, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Axios. Testing: Playwright, Jest, Vitest. Backend: Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Drizzle ORM, Supabase. Based in Chișinău, UTC+2/+3. Available immediately; remote, on-site in Chișinău, or relocation within the EU. Languages: Russian native, English B2, Romanian B2, Ukrainian B2.
